_comment: Idea starters on the welcome screen. id: saved by the overlay; label: the chip; brief: sent to OpenCode as its first prompt (empty: OpenCode starts blank). hackbox-agent adds the shared 'how to build here' tail. Installed to /etc/hackbox/ai/starters.json.
tail: How to build it here: first write a 5 line plan, then in ONE message launch these subagents in parallel with complete briefs (paths, ports, contract interface, API shapes): contract (write, fund the deployer with 0g-fund, deploy to 0G Galileo, write address and ABI to frontend/src/contract.json), frontend (Vite + React app in ./frontend on port 5173, polished dark UI with the 0G purple palette), designer (after the first UI exists: polish layout, animations, loading and empty states), and when the app runs, reviewer (open it, click through every flow, fix every bug) and pitch (README.md and a 60 second demo script in DEMO.md). Outside data comes from the local mock API at http://127.0.0.1:4010 (GET / lists it) with a visible Mock data badge. The AI features are REAL 0G Compute: from the browser call POST http://127.0.0.1:4010/ai/chat with {prompt, system} (reply in .reply) or the OpenAI-compatible http://127.0.0.1:4010/v1/chat/completions with stream: true; label them Powered by 0G Compute. Start the dev server and tell me the URL to open in Firefox as soon as the first screen works, then keep improving it.

starters.label: AI market
starters.brief: Build an AI agent marketplace dapp on 0G. A home page lists AI models and agents as rich cards (from /ai/models and /ai/agents: name, creator, rating, price per call in 0G, runs, tags) with search, category filters and sorting. Each agent has a detail page with a live Try it chat that answers in that agent's persona using real 0G Compute, streaming the reply. Creators can list a new agent through a form; an AI button writes the agent's description and tagline for them. Contract AgentMarket: listAgent(name, metadataURI, pricePerCall) and payable callAgent(agentId) that pays the creator and emits AgentCalled; the UI shows the on-chain listings next to the mock ones and a Pay and run button that sends the testnet 0G transaction with the user's wallet (MetaMask on 0G Galileo) before the chat answers.

starters.label: Trading
starters.brief: Build an AI trading dashboard on 0G. A pro trading layout: a watchlist of pairs with live prices and 24h change (/markets, /prices, polling every 2 s), a big candlestick chart with interval switcher (/candles, use lightweight-charts), an order book and recent trades panel (/orderbook, /trades), and a portfolio card (/portfolio). An AI copilot side panel uses real 0G Compute: it reads the current candles, order book and news (/news) and streams a market analysis, a sentiment score and a suggested trade with reasoning; a one click Explain this chart button too. Contract TradeJournal: users record paper trades on-chain (pair, side, size, price, the AI's reason) and the dashboard shows their on-chain journal with live profit and loss against the mock prices.

starters.label: AI agent
starters.brief: Build an on-chain AI agent studio on 0G. Users create an agent with a name, avatar emoji, personality and goals; it is minted as an NFT (contract AgentNFT, ERC-721 with the persona in on-chain metadata). Each agent gets a full screen chat that streams answers from real 0G Compute in its persona, with tools it can use: live prices (/prices), news (/news) and the user's portfolio (/portfolio), shown as tool cards in the chat. After each conversation the agent writes a one line memory; the app stores the memory hashes on-chain (AgentNFT.addMemory) and shows the agent's memory timeline. A gallery page shows all minted agents with a Chat button.

starters.label: NFT drop
starters.brief: Build an AI generated NFT drop on 0G. The user types a theme; real 0G Compute generates a collection: names, descriptions, rarity traits and the artwork itself as SVG code (ask the model for a self-contained 512x512 SVG), previewed live as cards with a shimmer while generating. A mint page mints the chosen piece with contract AINFTDrop (ERC-721, fully on-chain SVG in tokenURI as base64 JSON, max supply, mint price in testnet 0G). Show a collection gallery with the minted items and a marketplace strip from /marketplace/listings (mock). Add an AI critic button that rates and roasts a piece.
